caseName: Santa Fe Independent School District v. Doe
caseNameFull: Santa Fe Independent School District v. Doe, Individually and as Next Friend for Her Minor Children

opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of Rutherford Institute for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted limited to the following question: “Whether petitioner’s policy permitting student-led, student-initiated prayer at football games violates the Establishment Clause?”
